name: kxcbdecisioncanada
title: What will the Bank of Canada decide at its next policy meeting?
settlement: Resolves to the outcome matching the Bank of Canada's announced change to its overnight policy rate at the scheduled meeting: hike more than 25bps, hike 25bps, maintain, cut 25bps, or cut more than 25bps. Exactly one outcome resolves Yes, per the Bank's official announcement.
decideContext: Estimate how the news shifts the likelihood of the Bank of Canada's rate action (hike, hold, or cut, and size) at its next scheduled meeting. The market resolves on the Bank's official policy rate announcement, with one outcome Yes among five.
